item.tib: mchog gsum gsang ba'i mdel kha las mdos kyi spyi 'phyong g.yung drung bkod pa
item.coloph: 'di ni bla chen dran pa yis/ thugs kyi man ngag bcud phyung cing*/ g.yung drung bon gyi yang bcud bsdus/ skong mdos bzlog (zlog) mdos bsad mdos sogs/ mdos rigs yongs la mkho ba'i bon/ mdos 'phyong g.yung drung bkod pa 'di/ zab pa thegs (theg) chen gdams pa 'dra/ 'tshogs pa rin chen gter gling 'dra/ 'phang ba yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ gces pa dpral ba'i mig dang 'dra/ bka' rgya stang chen khyed la gtad/ mi 'chol gsang dam thub par gyis/ u rgyan 'gro don dus bab tshe/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma la/ zag med dgongs pa brda yis brgyud/ ma 'ong rtsod ldan bskal pa la/ gsang 'dus hris pa pad 'byung dang*/ nga yi sku gsung thugs sprul la/ g.yung drung thog (thogs) med zhes bya ba/ sme ba'i ga sha yod pa 'byung / de la bon 'di 'phrod bar gyis/ de dus bar chod byed pa rnams/ lha srin dregs pas gsol zas gyis/ zhes pa'i bka' bsgo dang bcas nas/ stang chen nyid la zhal gyis gdams/ dmu tshas mkha' 'gror dgongs pas brgyud/ de nas chu yos zla 8 tshes la/ nges med rnal 'byor bdag (la) brgyud/ bco (bco) brgyad lo yi bka' rgya de/ grol nas 'bri ba'i dus bab tshe/ zhig mchog bla ma'i bka' gnang ngor/ kun dga'i ming gi (gis) yi ger phab/ nyes 'gal mchis na lha la bshags/ legs lam zab gsang bon yin na/ 'di la ya ga byed pa rnams/ lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs kyi bsgrol (kyis sgrol)'di la mos shing brtson pa rnams/ dga' bde / phun sum 'tshogs ('tshog) pa dang / gang bsam yid bzhin 'grub par shog/
